report.title: ClinePass Models Monitoring

narrative.summary: # Weekly Monitoring Summary **Blended usage shifts:** DeepSeek V4 Pro 0423 rose from 0.20 to 2.46 (11.1×) and Qwen3.7 Plus from 0.13 to 2.49 (17.5×). **Quality scores added:** GLM 5.3 Flash (27.8), Nemotron 3.5 Lightning free (5.5), Beam (17.7). **Rate changes:** Both models moved from "measured" to "reference" provenance, so price drops aren't directly comparable. Qwen3.7 Plus fell ~40% (input 0.67→0.40, output 2.67→1.60); DeepSeek V4 Pro fell 20–27% across classes. **Catalog:** No models added or removed.

warnings: measured rates differ from the dated reference table by more than 1.5x for: deepseek-v4.1-flash (0.50x of the reference); the measured fit is published, so treat the reference table as stale for these models
the reference rate table was published 28 days ago (2026-10-02); catalog entries added since then have no fallback rate and are published without a price unless their own fit is estimable
4 catalog model(s) have no reference rate entry: deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017, kimi-k3.1-pro, mimo-v2.6-pro, minimax-m3.1-flash; they are priced only when their own usage fit is accepted

plan.name: Cline Pass (Monthly)[Internal]
plan.description: Cline Pass brings agentic coding to programmers around the world. Offering generous limits and reliable access to the most capable open-source models, so you can build with powerful agents without worrying about cost or availability.

included: Built for as many programmers as possible
Includes DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor, GLM-5.3, Kimi K3, Qwen3.8 Max, DeepSeek V4 Pro, GLM-5.3-Flash, Qwen3.7 Plus, Qwen3.7 Max, MiniMax-M3, MiMo-V2.5-Pro, and MiMo-V2.5
